registries.name: Start9 Registry
registries.description:
The primary registry for StartOS, run by Start9.

Every service here is **maintained** by Start9 — packaged, tested against the current StartOS release, and kept up to date — **recommended** for quality and usefulness, and **supported** by Start9's technical support.

This is the general-purpose registry. A family of services that forms a stack of its own may receive a dedicated registry, so the whole stack is listed together.

Looking for something that isn't here? Browse the Community Registry.

registries.name: Community Registry
registries.description:
The open registry for StartOS, run by Start9 and stocked by independent developers.

Any service can be published here, whoever wrote it, provided it meets the technical requirements for listing, conforms to the packaging guide, and doesn't belong in a dedicated registry. Listing is a technical bar, not an endorsement: each service is maintained by its own developer, and the range reflects what the community has chosen to package.

To list a service of your own, follow the [packaging guide](https://docs.start9.com/packaging); help with packaging is in the [service packaging room](https://matrix.to/#/#dev-service-packaging:matrix.start9labs.com) on Matrix.

warning.en_US: Services from this registry are packaged and maintained by members of the Start9 community. Install at your own risk. If you experience an issue or have a question related to a service in this marketplace, please reach out to the package developer for assistance.
warning.de_DE: Dienste in diesem Register werden von der Start9-Community gepflegt. Die Installation erfolgt auf eigenes Risiko. Bei Problemen wenden Sie sich bitte an den Paketentwickler.
warning.es_ES: Los servicios de este registro están empaquetados y mantenidos por miembros de la comunidad Start9. Instálalos bajo tu propio riesgo. Si experimentas un problema o tienes una pregunta sobre un servicio en este mercado, comunícate con el desarrollador del paquete.

registries.name: Beta Registry
registries.description:
Pre-release builds of the services in the Start9 Registry.

New versions of Start9 services are published here before they reach the Start9 Registry. Switching to this registry lets you install and update to those builds ahead of general release; the same versions arrive in the Start9 Registry once they have proven themselves.

Testing is coordinated in the [service testing room](https://matrix.to/#/#dev-service-testing:matrix.start9labs.com) on Matrix — report what you find there.

warning.en_US: Services from this registry are undergoing beta testing. Bugs are expected. Install at your own risk.

warning.fr_FR: Les services de cette bibliothèque sont en phase de test bêta. Des bugs sont à prévoir. Installez-les à vos risques et périls.
warning.pl_PL: Serwisy z tego katalogu są w fazie testów beta. Należy spodziewać się błędów. Instalujesz je na własne ryzyko.
